instructions_for_operator: Create repo, enable Pages in Settings. No API key needed for static deployment via git.
Create free account (10,000 subscribers free), get API key at kit.com/settings/account. Add KIT_API_KEY to .env.
Create account, get integration token at medium.com/me/settings. Add MEDIUM_ACCESS_TOKEN to .env.
Create account, get API key at dev.to/settings/account. Add DEVTO_API_KEY to .env.
Create account, generate token at gumroad.com/settings. Add GUMROAD_ACCESS_TOKEN to .env.
Create account, get API key at ko-fi.com/developer. Add KOFI_API_KEY to .env.
Create free account (5% fee on free plan). No API key needed for manual product listing.
Create account, generate API key at lemonsqueezy.com/settings/api. Add LEMONSQUEEZY_API_KEY to .env.
Apply for affiliate account. No API key needed for manual link generation. Add AMAZON_ASSOCIATE_TAG to .env when approved.
Create developer account and app. Add all four keys to .env.
Create app at reddit.com/prefs/apps. Add credentials to .env.
Create Google Cloud project, enable YouTube Data API v3, create credentials.
Create business account, get access token at developers.pinterest.com/. Add PINTEREST_ACCESS_TOKEN to .env.
Create developer account and app. Add all three keys to .env.
Create free creator account, apply to UGC campaigns. No API key needed for manual application.
Create free creator account, browse live UGC campaigns. No API key needed.
Create free tester account, complete practice test. No API key needed.
Create account, get API key at seomatic.ai/settings/api. Add SEOMATIC_API_KEY to .env.
Create account, generate token at vercel.com/account/tokens. Add VERCEL_TOKEN to .env.
